children: Liquid assets in Russia's national wealth fund (NWF) stood at $46.7 billion as of September 1, or 1.7% of projected gross domestic product for 2026, up from $46.2 billion a month earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.

Total assets in the wealth fund, which include investments in domestic infrastructure projects, fell to the equivalent of $154.1 billion or 5.6% of GDP, compared to $159.3 billion at the start of August, the ministry said.
